text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's been a while, but it's finally time for our targeted race.
I've waited half a year for this moment!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. El is no longer
the same El from when she debuted!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The powerfully grown,
Super Fantástica El-El!!
That is who I am desu!"

Indeed, with the passage of time,
El Condor Pasa's abilities have improved dramatically.

"Conquering the Japan Cup in the Classic year."
The challenge toward that major goal begins here.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And what's more! El's strength wasn't the only thing that leveled up with a BAM!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"There's one more thing that's gotten stronger!
And that is—this, DESU!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno, Spe-chan!
Our friends' cheers give us a twenty percent power boost-desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Over this half year, our friendship has become harder than iron,
hotter than flame, enough to set our hearts ablaze-desu!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El~, if you put on an embarrassing race, no dinner for you, okay~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, Grass! I will not let you pass, whether it's running or eating!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...So you see, Trainer.
When El gets fired up by her friends and fans...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Several times over!
No, it unleashes tens of thousands of times more power, YES!

Tens of thousands of times might be an exaggeration.
Even so—
choice_data_list: Then why don't you show me?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~? Don't tell me you don't believe me?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
Then I'll show you right now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Watch as El becomes a true Condor
and shoots down the Tokyo straightaway—!!
